request.prompt_preview: CASE FILE Question: Customers in Tunis and Sfax complained yesterday around lunchtime that web pages and apps would not load, even though their phones showed full signal. What was going on? Now: 2026-

response.text: The investigation shows that a nationwide DNS degradation occurred yesterday between 12:00 and 14:00 (ALR-0001), coinciding precisely with customer complaints about web pages and apps failing to load. This was triggered by a software upgrade patch (`CHG-2026-0001`) applied on `CORE-DNS-01` at 11:00, which led to a spike in resolution latency and a drop in query success percentage, alongside alarm `ALM-000003` (`DNS_TIMEOUT_RATE`). Since DNS resolution is essential for translating web domains, its failure explains why apps and web pages would not load despite users having full signal.
